CARES PostgreSQL Round 3.2 — Dependency and Blocker Map (Round 3.2.1 Fidelity-Corrected)

Status: Proposed governance dependency/blocker record only; NOT IMPLEMENTED, NOT TESTED, NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZATION.
Round: Round 3.2 — Owner Decision Consolidation and Governance Reconciliation; Round 3.2.1 — Owner Decision Fidelity Correction (documentation/governance only).
Verified source baseline: governance/postgresql-round3-2-owner-decision-consolidation @ cd950882b0ea0e58781d9ba8f10440bd383f9b58.
Working branch: governance/postgresql-round3-2-1-owner-decision-fidelity-correction.

1. Purpose and classification

This document reconciles dependencies and blocker classifications for OD-001–OD-013, preserved unresolved PD-001–PD-012, ADR 0006 (Proposed), and I-00–I-14 against the authoritative Round 3.2.1 fidelity-corrected owner-approved principles and bounded conditions (see POSTGRESQL_ROUND3_2_OWNER_DECISION_REGISTER.md).

Classification scheme (required):

  • Owner-approved principle (bounded): authoritative governing principle and bounded conditions approved; not unconditional technical/implementation authorization.
  • Technically unresolved: specific technical details, mechanisms, formulas, policies, predicates, validations, or approvals not explicitly finalized/approved.
  • Implementation-dependent: requires implementation design/execution/validation evidence that is not present and not authorized in this round.
  • Governance-dependent: requires separate formal governance action/approval (e.g. ADR status transition, increment authorization, policy approval) not provided here.

Critical rule: approval of a principle does not mark a technical blocker resolved. No item is closed/inferred as resolved unless explicitly evidenced and authorized within scope.

4. ADR 0006 and increment blocker reconciliation

  • ADR 0006: Owner-approved principle (bounded) via OD-001; formal status remains Proposed (governance-dependent for any future formal transition). Bounded exclusions/deferred dependencies and OD-003/OD-004/OD-008 dependencies preserved. Not an implementation authorization.
  • I-00–I-05, I-07, I-08, I-10, I-11: conditionally planning-ready in bounded contexts only (where preserved), but no execution/implementation authorization; blocked by unresolved technical/governance prerequisites and absence of explicit authorization.
  • I-06: blocked for final semantics and correctness-critical execution (not authorized) despite bounded OD principles; depends on unresolved OD-001/003/004/005/008/OD-013 and related technical approvals/validations.
  • I-09: not authorized; OD-010/OD-011 principles do not authorize automation/final enforcement/implementation.
  • I-12: hard blocked / not authorized (PD-005/PD-006 and required isolation/validation evidence unresolved).
  • I-13: blocked/out of scope / not authorized (runtime correctness-critical; depends on blocked/unresolved prerequisites including I-12 and approved semantics).
  • I-14: deferred/blocked / not authorized (evidence- and governance-dependent per OD-010/OD-012/PD-010).
  • Explicitly authorized implementation increments: None.

5. Conclusion

OD-001–OD-013 provide authoritative, bounded governance principles; they do not resolve all technical details, do not close PD-001–PD-012, do not promote ADR 0006 formal status beyond Proposed, and do not authorize I-00–I-14 implementation. All implementation remains unauthorized pending separately satisfied prerequisites, explicit approvals/authorizations, technical finalization, and validation evidence as applicable.
